act_title: THE CHITTAGONG HILL-TRACTS AERIAL ROPEWAYS REGULATION, 1960

sections.section_content: 1. (1) This Regulation may be called the Chittagong Hill- tracts Aerial Ropeways Regulation, 1960.(2) It shall come into force at once

2. The BengalAerial Ropeways Act, 1923(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), and the rules made thereunder shall, subject to the following amendments, apply to the Chittagong Hill-tracts, namely:AmendmentsAmendment of the long title and the preamble1.In the long title and the preamble of the said Act,forthe word "Bengal" occurring twice, the words1[Bangladesh]shall besubtituted.Amendment of section 1 of theBen. Act VII of 19232.Sub-sections(2)and(3)of section 1 of the said Act shall beomitted.

3. In section 2 of the said Act,-(a) in clause (1) for the words "an aerial ropeway", the words "an aerial ropeway or overhead monorail crane" shall be substituted;(b) for clause (3), the following shall be substituted, namely:-"(3) “Deputy Commissioner” means the Deputy Commissioner of the Chittagong Hill-tracts and includes any officer specially appointed by the2[Government] to discharge the functions of a Deputy Commissioner under this Regulation;";(c) forsub-clause(iv)of clause (9), the following shall besubstituted, namely:-"(iv)any company incorporated under the Companies Act, 1913."; and(d)sub-clause(v)of clause (9) shall beomitted.

4. In section 5 of the said Act, for the words, figures and commas "and of section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894,", the words, figures and commas "and of section 3 ofChittagong Hill-tracts (Land Acquisition) Regulation, 1958' href='/act-1363.html'>THEChittagong Hill-tracts (Land Acquisition) Regulation, 1958," shall be substituted.
5. In clause (vii) of sub-section (6) of the said Act, the words "the Federal Railway Authority or" shall be omitted.
6. In section 12 of the said Act, for the words "Indian Penal Code", the words "3[***] Penal Code" shall be substituted.
7. In section 14 of the said Act, for the word "Collector" occurring twice, the words "Deputy Commissioner" shall be substituted.
8. In sub-section (2) of section 15 of the said Act, for the word "Collector", the words "Deputy Commissioner" shall be substituted.
9. In section 16 of the said Act, for the words "Collector" occurring thrice, the words "Deputy Commissioner" shall be substituted.

10. In section 17 of the said Act,-(a) for the word "Collector" occurring twice, the words "Deputy Commissioner" shall be substituted; and(b) for the words "District Judge", the words "Commissioner of Chittagong Division" shall be subtituted.
11. In clause (a) of section 20 of the said Act, for the words "Indian Penal Code", the words"4[***] Penal Code" shall be substituted.
12. In sub-section (2) of section 26 of the said Act, the words, figures and commas "notwithstanding anything contained in the Provincial Insolvency Act, 1920," shall be omitted.

13. In sub-section (1) of section 28 of the said Act, for the words, figures and commas "of Part VII of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, or procure the temporary occupation of the same under the provisions of Part VI of the said Act, whether the said promoter is or is not a company as defined in that Act", the words, figures and commas "ofChittagong Hill-tracts (Land Acquisition) Regulation, 1958' href='/act-1363.html'>THEChittagong Hill-tracts (Land Acquisition) Regulation, 1958" shall be substituted.
14. Section 30 of the said Act shall be omitted.
15. In clause (c) of section 33 of the said Act, for the words "Indian Penal Code", the words"5[***] Penal Code" shall be substituted.
16. In section 34 of the said Act, for the words "Indian Penal Code", the words"6[***] Penal Code" shall be substituted.

17. In section 38 of the said Act, for the words, figures and commas "of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894", the words, figures and commas "ofChittagong Hill-tracts (Land Acquisition) Regulation, 1958' href='/act-1363.html'>THEChittagong Hill-tracts (Land Acquisition) Regulation, 1958," shall be substituted.
